recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, retro-themed composition featuring a group of five performers in white togas against a yellow and orange sunburst background. The design incorporates classical Greek motifs, bold outlined typography, and a grainy, vintage print texture characteristic of mid-century record sleeves.
coreVisualRelationships: Sunburst rays radiating from a central point behind the subjects
Greek key (meander) borders framing the horizontal sections
High-contrast black and white photography against a saturated primary color palette
Layered, heavy-stroked typography overlapping the background and subjects
coreInvariants: Black and white Greek key border
Blue text with thick black and white outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged in a horizontal row across the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized display text at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top display text, moves down through the sunburst rays to the group of figures, and settles on the secondary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with patterns, figures, and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow and orange sunburst background providing high energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white photography and borders for graphic clarity.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sky blue used for the primary and secondary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and text contrasted with the grayscale values of the human subjects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed slab serif and casual script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-condensed, tall vertical proportions with sharp slab serifs
Secondary text uses a fluid, brush-style script
All display text features a double outline: a thin white inner stroke and a thick black outer stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated verticality in the main title
Interlocking or tightly kerned characters to create a solid block of color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A rigid, tall slab serif paired with a bouncy, informal script for a dynamic 'showbiz' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tall, slab-serif western/circus aesthetic of the era
Matches the informal secondary text style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1960s album cover background featuring a yellow and orange radial sunburst. Include a black and white Greek key (meander) border across the middle and bottom. Place five people in the foreground wearing simple white togas, rendered in high-contrast black and white photography with a grainy texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-condensed slab-serif text at the top in sky blue with a thick black and white double outline. Add a smaller script font below it. Add a repeating phrase at the bottom in the same blue outlined slab-serif style.

verificationChecks: Is the sunburst centered behind the subjects?
Does the text have the characteristic double outline?
Are the Greek key borders present?
Is the photography high-contrast black and white?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture looks like printed cardboard/paper.
Check that the blue text is legible against the yellow/orange background.
Verify the 'toga' theme is clearly communicated through the costumes.
Confirm the Greek key borders are aligned horizontally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a radial sunburst background with classical architectural borders and high-contrast B&W photography for a 'Retro-Classical' pop aesthetic.
